notes.title: Waifus Smash 5 minute gameplay preview - the biggest game Galart has ever made!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We just received news from our partner - Galart team, they have updated a 5 minutes video of gameplay preview so we post this announcement to let anyone who is interested know.

You can see it directly on their store page here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602490/Waifus_Smash/

We also had the honor of getting to test the game early on and it was really cool!
A mixed of hentai - RPG - Rhythm-based combat-puzzle game with a lot of exciting music.
The game will come the next day. Wishlist now!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 bug fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you a lot for your support and feedback on our game. 
Here is today update changelog:
- Fixed 3 "This is option" bugs
- Fixed moving pantsu to inventory making a duplicate set.
- Fixed Some questions have incorrect answer causing no points on correct pick.
- Fixed Ultra wide resolution.
- Improve and fix English & Chinese dialog bug (In progress)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Thank you a lot for your support and feedback on our game. 
We are working on fixing bug and improving player experience throughout the game. Please tell us more about your opinions and suggestions in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1379830/discussions/0/2994295183856796695/][Discussion][/url] forum.
Changelog:
- Change Favorite pet in profile to Favorite Partner Trait.
- Fix Girl quizz profile unlock.
- Fix Clinic Order game drop to -1 and got stuck.
- Fix unlock Challenge mode.
- Emphasize Clinic feature on sidebar.
- Improve and fix English & Chinese dialog bug (In progress)
